decisions.reason: The source directly revises landing-page mechanics wording, but the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY covering the new headline and explanation, emphasis guidance, and removal of both obsolete slogans.
The source is limited to landing-page hero layout, cover presentation, and landing-page wording; it does not direct changes to the About page.
The source changes specific landing-page copy and presentation but does not revise the FAQ content.
The source directly changes the cover's placement, permissible size, and crop treatment, and those changes are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The source concerns the landing page and does not require any change to the independently maintained Mission page.
References to the dashboard and prize copy do not change winner announcement channels, notification channels, conditions, or email guidance.
The source does not change public pool APIs or the next-draw sales counter; the dashboard-button overlap is only a hero-layout issue.
The source revises promotional wording about tickets but does not alter ticket counters, dashboard ticket display, ticket association, or accounting behavior.
The source does not discuss the certificate email, its contents, reading action, or download link.
Mentioning a referral link in landing-page copy does not change the referral code's identity, lifetime, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior.
The source changes how the existing $500-every-100-sales mechanism is worded and emphasized, not the underlying Small Block prize rules, which remain valid unchanged.
Using '$5 unlimited, instant commission' as emphasized landing-page copy does not change the commission amount, trigger, recipient, payout behavior, limit, or expiration.
